info.name: GraphCal
info.summary: Two-way sync between Nextcloud Calendar and Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online calendars
info.description:
**Caution: this app is entirely AI-generated.** It is tested against a Microsoft 365 tenant in production, and by automated tests on Nextcloud 33–35 and Nextcloud All-in-One.
GraphCal mirrors your Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online calendars into Nextcloud and pushes changes made in Nextcloud back, using Microsoft Graph.
Meeting invitations, updates, cancellations and replies for synced calendars are sent by **Exchange**, not by Nextcloud, so Outlook users get native meeting requests.
**Data & privacy:** after a user connects their Microsoft account, the events of their synced calendars (title, time, location, description, attendees) are exchanged with Microsoft Graph. OAuth tokens are stored encrypted in Nextcloud. Users can disconnect at any time in their personal settings; this deletes the tokens and the sync state.
Requires an Entra ID app registration created by the administrator (see the README).
